method: Decoded all 500 frames; inspected 20 frames at one-second intervals and 15 frames at 0.08-second intervals from 3.00 to 4.12 seconds.
observations: The sampled frames show repeated foot lift and replacement, floor-grid translation and a level deck. The camera follows the robot. The numerical trace measures 0.9676 m of forward world displacement over the full trial.
limitations: The sampled images do not establish gait-quality acceptance or exclude motion above the 25 fps recording rate. The original forward tracking check fails. No human acceptance is recorded.
